acceptance_profile.sane_row: isfinite(N0) && N0 > 0 && all(isfinite, F) && 1e-3 < sigma_own/sigma_bote < 1e3; a row failing twice is not written (fail-closed)

boundary: This file lists the inputs that causally determine the table values. How they are implemented is fixed by generator_commit and generator_source_fingerprint in each table file, not by this hash.

e0_grid_rule.merge: sorted union; drop a node within 2 % (ratio <= 1.02) of the previous kept node, unless it is an absolute node, which then replaces the previous

eps_quadrature.segments: 1: eps in [0, E_th], eps = E_th*x^2, Gauss-Legendre n1 on x in (0,1) / 2: eps in [E_th, (D+E_th)/2], log-uniform, n2 / 3: upper end, D - eps = scale*y^2, n3; D = E0 - E_th. Low overvoltage (D <= 2 E_th): segments 1 and 3 only

lkin.containment: r_eff = r_b[i], i = first index with cumsum(rho .* gradient_(r_b)) >= radius_frac * total; rho = G^2 + F^2 on the Dirac path, u_b^2 otherwise
lkin.l_max: min(l_cap, max(6, min(l_kin, l_barrier))); l_kin = ceil(kappa * r_eff) + margin; l_barrier = floor(sqrt(2 r_c + 2 eps r_c^2)), r_c = r_core + 2

s_cert.rule: largest S_GRID point <= min(S_GRID[end], margin / lambda_e(E0)) (+1e-12 tolerance); F is exactly 0 beyond it

tail.eps_rule: eps = max(EPS_FLOOR, EPS_SAFETY * sup|F| on [s_cert - EPS_WINDOW, s_cert])
